analysis_notes.topic: Jared Goff MVP evaluation and blitz performance
analysis_notes.summary: Jared Goff has thrown for 1,788 yards, 14 TDs, and 0 INTs through 6 games, ranking #1 in EPA per dropback and #3 in passer rating vs. blitz.
analysis_notes.speaker: Andrew Erickson
analysis_notes.quote: Number one in EPA per dropback... he's been playing at an MVP level.

analysis_notes.topic: Rest disparity and fading post-international travel
analysis_notes.summary: Teams playing immediately after international travel without a bye week are 3-6 ATS season-long and 0-4 ATS following London games.
analysis_notes.speaker: Andrew Erickson
analysis_notes.quote: Teams after a neutral site international game without a bye week... those teams are 3 and 6 against the spread.

analysis_notes.topic: Eagles running back depth chart injuries
analysis_notes.summary: Eagles down to fifth-string running back options due to Saquon Barkley hamstring strain and Damien Pierce landing on injured reserve.
analysis_notes.speaker: Andrew Erickson
analysis_notes.quote: Eagles are down to their fifth string running back... this backfield is cursed.

analysis_notes.topic: Chiefs vs. Broncos red-zone defensive strength
analysis_notes.summary: Both Chiefs (2nd) and Broncos (7th) rank top-10 in red-zone defense and allowed points per game, driving heavy under trends.
analysis_notes.speaker: Andrew Erickson
analysis_notes.quote: Both top 10 in terms of passing defense... Chiefs second best defense in the red zone, Broncos rank seventh.
